name: 2Modern
desc:
Customer Service Representative | Est. $18-$22/hr | Email, Phone and Chat Support, No Sales Expectations
Company: 2Modern
Industry: Ecommerce / Modern Furniture, Lighting and Décor
What Your Day Will Look Like: You'd be the person customers hear from after they've already bought something. A customer wants to know where their sofa is, a delivery needs to be coordinated, something arrived damaged, or a return needs approving. You'd research the order, track the shipment with carriers and vendors, and reach out before the customer has to ask. You'd handle damage claims, return authorizations, and cancellations, and sometimes bend the rules a little when it makes sense, while still protecting the business. Everything gets documented in Zendesk so the next person who touches the order knows the full story. The customers are homeowners and design professionals who expect a hotel concierge level of care, so tone matters as much as speed.
assessment: Expect a basic assessment, a typing test, and a home internet speed test, since the posting doesn't state otherwise.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: Not stated in posting.
Required Experience: Experience in luxury retail, hospitality, or concierge settings is called out as a primary criterion, not a nice-to-have. Ecommerce customer service experience is also expected, ideally in a drop-ship or multi-vendor setup.
Preferred Experience: Zendesk, Shopify, or similar platforms. Genuine interest in design, home furnishings, or the trade.
Required Skills:
Warm, precise, composed written and verbal communication
Sound judgment about when to flex within policy
Ability to manage many open issues at once without losing track of any
Comfort with Zendesk, Shopify, or similar platforms
A problem-solving mindset that looks for the resolution, not just the response
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
Someone with hotel, restaurant, or other hospitality experience where guests expect a personal touch
Someone who writes clear, polished emails and stays calm when a customer is upset
Someone who likes chasing down answers from carriers and vendors until the issue is solved
Someone with an eye for design or home furnishings
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone with no customer service, hospitality, or retail background, since the experience line is stated outright
Anyone who wants a scripted, high-volume call center job
Anyone who can't work the late shift, which runs until 9:30 PM Central
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Post-purchase customer support
Order tracking and delivery coordination
Returns and damage claim handling
Multi-channel communication (email, phone, chat)
Ticket management and documentation
Luxury or hospitality service standards
Vendor and carrier follow-up
Judgment within policy
Managing multiple open cases
Professional written communication
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process: 1. Application 2. Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you. 3. If assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen. 4. If phone screen passes you can expect the final interview. Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3-15 days on average.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about your hospitality, luxury retail, or concierge experience and what excellent service meant in that setting.
Walk us through how you'd handle a customer whose furniture arrived damaged.
How do you keep track of many open issues at the same time?
Tell us about a time you bent a rule to keep a customer happy while still protecting the business.
How do you write an email that sounds warm and professional when you're delivering bad news about a delay?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: Not stated in posting. Estimated $18 to $22/hr based on third-party data, not confirmed by 2Modern. The application asks for your own hourly rate expectation, so confirm the actual offer directly.
Shift: Full-time, 40 hours a week, Monday through Friday, 11:00 AM to 7:30 PM Pacific (1:00 PM to 9:30 PM Central). Immediate start.
Benefits: Not stated in posting. Confirm directly.
Equipment Provided: Not stated in posting.
Felony Friendly?: Not stated.
Drug Test: Not stated.
Notes: The luxury service background is the real gate here, so this is not a true entry level role. A participant with hotel front desk, upscale restaurant, or retail experience is the best match. The application asks for three references, so a participant should have those lined up before applying. The 1:00 PM to 9:30 PM Central schedule is a late shift, so check that it works for the participant.
Career Pathway: Not stated in posting. Reasonable inferred path: Customer Service Representative → Senior Customer Service Representative → Customer Experience Lead → Customer Experience Manager, though this is an estimate, not confirmed by 2Modern directly.
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
